sign_up_offers.terms:
SingSaver Exclusive Welcome Offer promotion is valid from 1 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new customers of DCS cards only.
Apply and get approved for the DCS Ultimate Platinum Mastercard and meet the min. spend criteria within 30 days of card approval to be eligible for reward:
Make a min. spend of S$500 within 30 days of card approval to be eligible for a 
20-inch GOTRIP Luggage Bag
.
Make a min. spend of S$800 within 30 days of card approval to be eligible for a 
24-inch GOTRIP Luggage Bag
.
You will only receive one of the above rewards.
Additionally, accumulate a min. spend of S$1,000 in Qualifying Transactions within 30 days of the card approval date to be eligible for a 
S$50 Gojek Voucher
 on top of the above reward.
All of the above rewards are fulfilled by DCS.
Terms and Conditions
 apply.

extra.description: Stop leaving money on the table. The DCS Ultimate Platinum Mastercard delivers an automatic 2% cashback* on all your everyday spending with zero minimum spend requirements. Boost your wallet even further with an extra +2% bonus on direct airline and hotel bookings, giving you up to 4% total cashback. Simply link the card to Apple Pay or Google Pay, tap to pay, and watch your everyday savings grow effortlessly.
